errors.branch_removed:
building a branch on this machine is gone: a branch is installed as a preview build.
  1. gh workflow run octopus-preview.yml --ref main -f branch=<branch>
  2. allow previews here: OCTOPUS_UPDATE_CHANNELS=stable,preview in deploy/.env
  3. thulu update -version <x.y.z-dev.g<sha7>>   (the version the workflow printed)
errors.no_terminal: no terminal to confirm on; pass -yes
errors.pg_dump_cleanup_failed: pg_dump failed ({stderr}) and the partial file could not be removed
errors.report_format: -o {path}: the change package is written as .md or .json
errors.report_too_large: the change package is {size} bytes, over {limit}
errors.not_digest_ref: {ref} is not a reference by digest
errors.no_daemon_image: the manifest has no daemon image
errors.lock_held: another update is running ({operator}, pid {pid} on {host}, since {since}); if it is not, remove {file}
errors.source_off_hint: {cause}; point {env} at a mirror (`thulu mirror` writes one) to update this install
errors.no_release_on_channels: {source} lists no release on the allowed channels ({env})
errors.channel_not_allowed: {version} is on the {channel} channel, which this install does not allow ({env}={value})
errors.kube_needs_version: a Kubernetes install keeps no version file here; pass -version
errors.version_not_set: {env} is not set in deploy/.env; pass -version or run `thulu update -version X`
errors.delegated_version_mismatch: this CLI is {self} but was started to apply {target}
errors.no_fetch_cli_mismatch: -no-fetch-cli: this binary is {self}; install the {target} CLI first, or drop the flag so it is downloaded and checked against the release manifest
errors.no_cli_for_platform: release {version} publishes no CLI for {platform}; install it yourself and pass -no-fetch-cli
errors.not_kept: {version} is not kept on this install (`thulu update -kept` lists them)
errors.no_update_on_record: no update on record for this install — nothing to roll back to
errors.nothing_older_kept: no version older than {current} is kept; name one with -to
errors.running_version_unknown: cannot tell which version runs now (the daemon does not answer and nothing is recorded); start it and retry
errors.unstamped_build: {current:%q} is an unstamped build: its schema cannot be compared with {version}
errors.target_older: {version} is older than the running {current}; going back is `thulu update -to {version}`
errors.upgrade_path: {version} upgrades only from {from}; update {current} to an intermediate release first
errors.dev_stack: the development stack runs your working tree; a release installs into deploy/docker-compose.yml or the standalone stack
errors.backup_failed:
backup failed, nothing was changed (migrations only run forward, so the snapshot is the way back): {cause}

Pass -backup-confirmed if you have your own
errors.requires_env: {version} requires {names} in deploy/.env; set it and retry
errors.external_backup_required: the database is external, so its backup is yours: snapshot it (PITR or a dump) and pass -backup-confirmed
errors.disk_space: {path} has {free} MB free; an update needs at least {need} MB for the snapshot
errors.manual_steps: {version} needs these steps done first; then pass -ack-manual-steps:{steps}
errors.restore_required: {version} may have migrated the database past what {current} reads, and this update took no snapshot: restore your own backup, then `thulu update -to {current} -restore {hint}`
errors.back_out_failed: update to {version} failed: {cause}; going back to {current} also failed: {errs}
errors.rolled_back: update to {version} failed and {current} is running again
errors.helm_rolled_back: helm upgrade to {version} failed and helm rolled the release back
errors.helm_rollback_failed: {version} did not come up ({cause}) and helm rollback failed: {rollback_err}
errors.previous_revision_back: {version} did not come up and the previous revision is back
errors.nothing_to_mirror_into: nothing to mirror into: pass -to <registry>, -dir <path>, or both
errors.mirror_preview_needs_cosign: {cause}; mirroring a preview checks its keyless signature with cosign
errors.no_cosign_signature: {ref} has no cosign signature to copy
errors.running_version_unknown_short: cannot tell which version runs now; start the daemon and retry
errors.target_newer: {version} is newer than the running {current}; that is an update: `thulu update -version {version}`
errors.restore_needed:
{current} goes back to {target} without a restore only when {target} is its rollback_to, and it is not: {current} may have migrated the database past what {target} reads.

  thulu update -to {target} -restore {snapshot}
errors.dev_stack_rollback: the development stack runs your working tree; check out the version instead
errors.restore_external_not_external: -restore external is for a database this install does not run; name a snapshot under backups/
errors.stopped_after_restore: {cause}; {service} is stopped and deploy/.env still names {version}
errors.cluster_restore_yours: a cluster's database is yours: restore it to the snapshot taken before {version} and pass -restore external
errors.helm_kept: helm upgrade to {version} failed and helm kept {current}
errors.database_unreachable: cannot reach the database from this host to restore the archive
errors.helm_values_missing: there is no {path} with this install's Helm values, and without them the upgrade would reset the release to the chart's defaults (SSO, the database DSN and the RuntimeClass included): pass -values <file>, or -reuse-values to keep the ones the release was installed with

cli.archive_backup_failed: archive backup failed ({err}) — falling back to a database dump
cli.dumping_database: dumping the database from the {service} container
cli.docker_unreachable: could not reach Docker to remove {what}: {err}
cli.keep_set_unknown: could not work out which images to keep, so none were removed: {err}
cli.list_images_failed: could not list images, so none were removed: {err}
cli.event_no_key: result not sent to the audit log: no API key (set OCTOPUS_API_KEY or pass -api-key-file)
cli.event_not_sent: warning: result not sent to the audit log: {err} (it is in {file})
cli.event_key_needs_admin: the key must belong to an admin of the operator workspace (OCTOPUS_OPERATOR_WORKSPACE) with the settings permission
cli.event_recorded: result recorded in the audit log
cli.running_cli: Running the {version} CLI ({path}, sha256 checked against the signed manifest)
cli.snapshot_remove_failed: could not remove the snapshot of {version}: {err}
cli.no_longer_kept: {version} is no longer kept: its snapshot and images go
cli.nothing_kept_yet: No versions kept yet: the list starts with the first `thulu apply`.
cli.unpinned: {version} leaves the list at the next update past {env}={keep}.
cli.commented_out: commented out {keys} outside the managed block of deploy/.env
cli.source_checkout: source checkout: git owns deploy/, so its files are left as they are
cli.no_daemon_url: no daemon URL to check; helm --wait was the readiness check
cli.plan_images_pull: Images    {signed} signed by the release key, {pull} to pull
cli.plan_backup_none: Backup    none needed: same version, no migrations
cli.plan_backup_dump: Backup    pg_dump into backups/ before anything changes
cli.plan_back_snapshot: Going back  needs the snapshot: `thulu update -to {version} -restore <snapshot>`
cli.plan_images: Images    {count} signed by the release key
cli.mirror_hint_source: OCTOPUS_UPDATE_SOURCE=<https URL or file:// path serving {dir}>
cli.plan_database_kept: Database  left as it is: {version} is the rollback_to of {current}
cli.restore_warning:
Restoring replaces every Thulu table, and anything written since the
snapshot was taken is lost.
cli.plan_database_external: Database  external, restored by you (-restore external)
cli.stopping_for_restore: stopping {service} so nothing writes during the restore

labels.daemon_not_answering: daemon not answering — it may be stopped
labels.dev_build: dev (an unstamped build: the working tree, not a release)
labels.install_unrecognized: unrecognized — no answers file and no running containers
labels.env_block_header: managed block, rewritten from the signed release manifest; do not edit
labels.env_superseded: superseded by the thulu apply block below
labels.images_no_longer_kept: Thulu images of versions no longer kept
labels.manual_step_set_var: set {name} in the chart values or the Secret they reference
labels.mirror_note: Unsigned. Where this mirror put each artifact of {manifest}; the digests are the signed manifest's, and apply reads that, not this file.
